title: Are You Washed in the Blood?
lyrics_original: Have you been to Jesus for the cleansing pow'r?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?
Are you fully trusting in His grace this hour?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?
Are you washed in the blood,
In the soul cleansing blood of the Lamb?
Are your garments spotless? Are they white as snow?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?
Are you walking daily by the Savior's side?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?
Do you rest each moment in the Crucified?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?
Are you washed in the blood,
In the soul cleansing blood of the Lamb?
Are your garments spotless? Are they white as snow?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?
When the Bridegroom cometh will your robes be white?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?
Will your soul be ready for the mansions bright,
And be washed in the blood of the Lamb?
Are you washed in the blood,
In the soul cleansing blood of the Lamb?
Are your garments spotless? Are they white as snow?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?
Lay aside the garments that are stained with sin,
And be washed in the blood of the Lamb;
There's a fountain flowing for the soul unclean,
O be washed in the blood of the Lamb!
Are you washed in the blood,
In the soul cleansing blood of the Lamb?
Are your garments spotless? Are they white as snow?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?

bible_verses.english: I told him, “My lord, you know.” He said to me, “These are those who came out of the great tribulation. They washed their robes, and made them white in the Lamb’s blood.
But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ, his Son, cleanses us from all sin.
According to the law, nearly everything is cleansed with blood, and apart from shedding of blood there is no remission.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for the precious gift of Your grace that cleanses my heart completely. I bring my stumbles and burdens to You today, trusting fully in the power of Your redeeming love. Wash me anew and help me to walk faithfully by Your side in every moment. May my life reflect the joy and freedom of being made white as snow in Your presence. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: This classic hymn invites us to pause and reflect on the profound gift of Christ's redemption. It is not a harsh interrogation, but a gentle invitation to step into the complete forgiveness made possible through Jesus' sacrifice. As we sing these searching questions, we are reminded that our spiritual purity doesn't come from our own striving, but from daily resting in His grace. Today, let His soul-cleansing love wash away every weight, leaving you renewed and walking closely by your Savior's side.
